1. Radio Communication Devices for San Antonio Fire Department (SAFD)/Emergency Operation Center (EOC)
ID#: 26-212791
 This contract will provide the purchase and delivery of six (6) new radio communication devices for the San Antonio Fire Department’s Emergency Medical Service Division. These radios and accessories will ensure safe, reliable communication between rescuers, helicopter pilots, crew members, and chiefs through waterproof, compatible systems during rescue operations. The Axnes, Inc. radio system is proprietary and currently installed in the San Antonio Police Department‘s (SAPD) helicopters. All component parts, including the integrated proprietary software, are designed, manufactured, and controlled exclusively by Axnes, Inc. These devices are not available from any other source and are engineered to integrate solely with SAPD-specified aircraft. submitted electronically.
Catalog Pricing. (This section applies to offers using catalog pricing unless this is a cooperative purchase.)

for purchase and installation of Building Automation System (BAS) controller devices to replace

In Control: City Council A Session
DEPARTMENT: Finance Department
DEPARTMENT HEAD: Troy Elliott
COUNCIL DISTRICTS IMPACTED: District 1
SUMMARY:
Submitted for City Council consideration and action is an amendment with Honeywell Building
Solutions (Honeywell) to provide the Convention & Sports Facilities (CSF) Department with the
purchase and installation of Building Automation System (BAS) controller devices for
the Enterprise Building Integrator (EBI) System to replace obsolete controllers for the Heating
Cooling Air Conditioning (HVAC) system. The Comfort Point OPEN BAS control devices which
consist of Direct Digital Controllers (DDC) and all associated field devices with ancillary
components and will replace the obsolete devices in the 1998 section of the Henry B. Gonzalez
Convention Center and the Lila Cockrell Theatre that were not upgraded in the 2016 expansion.
On January 26, 2023, City Council approved a contract with Honeywell Building Solutions
through Ordinance 2023-01-26-0019 for maintenance of software, hardware enhancement and
support of the EBI system for the Convention & Sports Facilities Department for a term of
February 1, 2023, through January 31, 2024, with a one, one year renewal option. On February
20, 2025, City Council approved ratification to an amendment through Ordinance 2025-02-20-

0117 to extend the contract with Honeywell Building Solutions by eight (8) months through
September 30, 2025, plus an additional renewal one year option, through September 30, 2026, to
allow the Convention and Sports Facilities to continue to receive maintenance for the safety and
functionality of the facility’s EBI System. Amendment V was approved to reduce the cost of
current one-year extension, with no change to the scope of service, that expires September 30,
2026.
Amendment VI will provide the Henry B. Gonzalez Convention Center and Lila Cockrell Theatre
with new controllers which will integrate with existing EBI System. Honeywell will remove
existing obsolete controllers and install Comfort Point OPEN BAS control devices consisting of
Direct Digital Controllers (DDC) and all associated devices and components in the amount of
$1,071,113.56, which increases the total contract value to $7,850,341.10, inclusive of original
contract amount and all previous amendments issued. The new system controllers will secure the
facility, maximize productivity, optimize assets, lower operating costs and safeguard the
occupants. The current controllers are obsolete and cost prohibitive to repair and maintain.
The EBI System is required to maintain the safety and functionality of the system which controls
the Convention Center’s life safety fire alarm system, automatic temperature controls, digital video
and surveillance cameras, electrical equipment, lighting, and associated equipment. The contract
includes labor, fire alarm testing, preventative maintenance, and 24/7 service for Henry B.
Gonzalez Convention Center, Lila Cockrell Theater, Lonesome Dove (LDR), Universidad
Nacional Autonoma de Mexico (UNAM) and the San Antonio and Mexican Culture Institute
(MCI). The original contract with Honeywell Building Solutions was procured on the basis of a
sole source exemption. Honeywell Building Solutions is the sole certified vendor of Honeywell
Building Solutions EBI System installed at the Henry B. Gonzalez Convention Center. Only
certified Honeywell technicians are authorized to install, service, move or add to any new EBI
System equipment to maintain the system warranty.
This amendment is exempt from SBEDA and Local Preference Programs. The Veteran-Owned
Small Business Program does not apply to goods/supplies and non-professional services contracts,
so no preference was applied to this contract.

Submitted for City Council consideration and action is an amendment for CNC Technologies LLC
to continue to provide the San Antonio Police Department (SAPD) and Office of Emergency
Management (OEM) with the Ground Receive System (GRS) Diversity Antenna Receive Site,
Directional Downlink Systems and CNC.Live (Downlink System) for City’s helicopter fleet. The
City has three helicopters currently utilizing the CNC Live Downlink System. The contract
provides oversight and coordination of CNC.Live Service; 24/7/365 live technical support, on-site
system and operational training for agency personnel; technical and operational consultation
services for Local, State and Federal agencies; and all parts and labor to repair or replace defective
components covered by factory warranty plus expedited factory service from original equipment
manufacturer for systems under warranty.

The CNC Downlink System is designed to transmit real time color or thermal based video images
wireless to assist with command and control during critical incidents for law enforcement and fire
operations as well as assisting field officers with their daily operations which includes locating
suspects and lost individuals or assisting with surveillance. The CNC downlink system provides
the SAPD Helicopter Unit with superior day and nighttime transmittable video capabilities which
are vital for command and control for SAPD, OEM, Southwest Texas Fusion Center and Mobile
Command Post. Through its enhanced technology and long range, the CNC Downlink System
ensures frequency coordination and full downlink interoperability with Texas Department of
Public Safety (DPS) and the Bexar County Emergency Operations Center during large scale
operations, critical incidents, or terrorist attacks. The CNC downlink system enhances situational
awareness and supports multi-agency response during large scale operations by serving as a
centralized resource for hosting, viewing, and sharing real-time aerial footage. The CNC downlink
system is compatible with existing microwave downlink equipment, searchlights, auto trackers,
moving maps, and global positioning systems.
On February 20, 2020, City Council approved a contract with CNC Technologies LLC through
Ordinance 2020-02-20-0096 for Request for Offer (RFO) 6100012076, Annual Contract for
Installation, Maintenance & Support of the Helicopter Video Down Link System at the San
Antonio Police Department in the estimated total amount of $1,800,000. The contract term was
upon award through November 30, 2020, with four additional, one-year periods through November
30, 2024. Amendment 1 aligned the SAPD and OEM CNC Technologies LLC licenses and
contract term to expire on September 30, 2025, for a cost of $7,790. Amendment 2 and 3 extended
the contract term and licenses by one month each through November 30, 2025, in the amount of
$16,344.66. This Amendment 4 is for CNC Technologies LLC to continue maintenance & support
of the Helicopter Video Down Link System for ten (10) months through September 30, 2026, for
a cost of $98,170.34; and this amendment includes four (4) additional one (1) year renewal options
through September 30, 2030, for a cost of $128,415 year 2; $134,840 year 3; $141,580 year 4; and
$148,660 year 5, for a total cost of $651,665.34. Upon approval of Amendment 4, the cumulative
total contact value will be $2,475,800 to include original contract and all associated amendments.
This contract amendment was procured utilizing a Public Health and Safety Exemption, citing a
requirement for brand specificity in order to enable SAPD to interact with the video transmissions
of the Texas Department of Public Safety, Dallas Police Department, Fort Worth Police
Department aircraft and the Bexar County Sheriff’s Departments Emergency Operations Center.
This amendment is exempt from SBEDA and Local Preference Programs. The Veteran-Owned
Small Business Program does not apply to goods/supplies and non-professional services contracts,
so no preference was applied to this contract.

1. Annual Contract for Hologic Platform and Supplies for the San Antonio Metro Health District (SAMHD)
ID#: 25-208121
Procurement Method: Request for Offer (RFO) – Sole Source
This annual contract will provide the San Antonio Metropolitan Health District (SAMHD), with the Hologic Testing platform and supplies for testing infectious diseases in compliance with the adopted test platform and analytical method selected for use in the Texas Public Health Laboratory System under the Texas Department of Health and Human Services. The supplies include test kits, collection tubes, and disposable tips with filters for testing of infectious diseases, specifically utilizing this platform. This contract will also provide maintenance and support of the Hologic equipment and platform.
